lines.text: 显影与刻蚀：两种ARC的退出方式不同
lines.zh: 显影与刻蚀：两种ARC的退出方式不同
lines.en: Development and etching: the two ARC types leave differently

lines.text: 显影去除 / BARC Open / 胶厚预算 / CD Bias
lines.zh: 显影去除 / BARC Open / 胶厚预算 / CD Bias
lines.en: Development removal / BARC Open / resist thickness budget / CD bias

lines.text: TARC常在显影/漂洗中退出；BARC常在显影后保留并需要刻蚀打开，具体依配方与膜系而定。
lines.zh: TARC常在显影/漂洗中退出；BARC常在显影后保留并需要刻蚀打开，具体依配方与膜系而定。
lines.en: TARC often leaves during development/rinsing; BARC often remains after development and requires opening by etching, depending on formulation and stack.

lines.text: TARC通常在显影/漂洗过程中被去除
lines.zh: TARC通常在显影/漂洗过程中被去除
lines.en: TARC is usually removed during development/rinsing

lines.text: BARC在显影后通常仍保留，需要刻蚀打开
lines.zh: BARC在显影后通常仍保留，需要刻蚀打开
lines.en: BARC usually remains after development and must be etched open

lines.text: 显影与刻蚀过程的关键参数决定图形质量
lines.zh: 显影与刻蚀过程的关键参数决定图形质量
lines.en: Key development and etching parameters determine pattern quality

lines.text: 在显影/漂洗中充分去除
lines.zh: 在显影/漂洗中充分去除

lines.text: • 避免残留、水印和表面缺陷
lines.zh: • 避免残留、水印和表面缺陷
lines.en: • Avoid residue, watermarks and surface defects
• Compatibility with PR and underlying materials

lines.text: • 刻蚀均匀性和各向异性
lines.zh: • 刻蚀均匀性和各向异性

lines.text: 更强的BARCOpen通常可降低残留，但会带来其他影响
lines.zh: 更强的BARCOpen通常可降低残留，但会带来其他影响
lines.en: Stronger BARC Open usually reduces residue but has other effects

lines.text: • 可能对下层材料造成损伤
lines.zh: • 可能对下层材料造成损伤

lines.text: 通过多种量测手段验证显影与刻蚀结果
lines.zh: 通过多种量测手段验证显影与刻蚀结果
lines.en: Verify development and etching results using multiple measurements

lines.text: • 刻蚀过程保留足够PR厚度
lines.zh: • 刻蚀过程保留足够PR厚度
lines.en: • Preserve sufficient PR thickness during etching

lines.text: • 兼顾圈形转移与分辨率
lines.zh: • 兼顾图形转移与分辨率

lines.text: • 避免PR过度损耗导致塌陷
lines.zh: • 避免PR过度损耗导致塌陷
lines.en: • Avoid collapse due to excessive PR loss

lines.text: • 避免侧壁回缩与不完整刻蚀
lines.zh: • 避免侧壁回缩与不完整刻蚀
lines.en: • Avoid sidewall recession and incomplete etching

lines.text: • 确保表面清洁与后续工艺窗口
lines.zh: • 确保表面清洁与后续工艺窗口
lines.en: • Ensure clean surfaces and downstream process windows

lines.text: 两种ARC在显影与刻蚀中的典型风险
lines.zh: 两种ARC在显影与刻蚀中的典型风险
lines.en: Typical development and etching risks for the two ARC types

lines.text: • 影响分能串与工艺廚口
lines.zh: • 影响分辨率与工艺窗口
• 侧壁回缩 / 角度变化

lines.en: CD comparison before and after etching

lines.text: 显影与刻蚀质量直接影响后续工艺
lines.zh: 显影与刻蚀质量直接影响后续工艺
lines.en: Development and etch quality directly affect subsequent processes

lines.text: • 评估图形整体形恩•验证淸洁度
lines.zh: • 评估图形整体形貌；• 验证清洁度
lines.en: • Evaluate overall pattern profile; • Verify cleanliness
• Verify the effects of the etch process

lines.text: • 确认是否在可接受范園
lines.zh: • 确认是否在可接受范围
lines.en: • Confirm it is within an acceptable range
• Relates to yield and design rules

lines.text: 可显影BARC、特殊Topcoat及多层胶体系的退出方式可能不同，需根据具体材料体系、光学设计和工艺需求进行选择与验证。
lines.zh: 可显影BARC、特殊Topcoat及多层胶体系的退出方式可能不同，需根据具体材料体系、光学设计和工艺需求进行选择与验证。
lines.en: Developable BARC, special Topcoats and multilayer resist systems may leave differently; select and validate based on the specific materials, optical design and process requirements.
